messages:
sean-sales: Quick heads-up — AcmeHealth kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. They want a short POC (4 weeks) to validate: clinical note summarization + EMR-aware Q&A. Need: success criteria, model fit (context + tool calling), and an initial pricing ask from procurement.
maria-ml: Do we have clarity on input size? they mentioned 'full encounter bundles' — could be 15k-30k tokens per request.
alex-eng: If it's 30k tokens we should use a 32k-context variant. We have optimized 32k builds that keep kv-cache efficient. latency will be higher than 8k models but still OK for batch/async use.
sean-sales: @maria-ml can you confirm whether they require real-time (interactive) answers or are ok with <2s (user-facing)? procurement also asked about SLA tiers.
maria-ml: Clinicians want near-real-time, ideally <1s for short queries, but for full-note summarization they accept up to 3s. We should capture both in success criteria.
jordan-ps: For tool calling — they must look up lab results and medication lists from their EMR. We should propose a limited tool with strict RBAC and sandboxed outputs. Example API we can expose:
```http
POST /tools/emr_lookup
{
  "patient_id": "12345",
  "query": "latest A1c"
}
```
returns structured JSON with `value`, `date`, `source`.
ina-ps: (typo) sorry meant jordan-ps ^
ina-ps: also: we'll need sample prompts from them to design evals.
ina-ps: (actually our AE will dump prompts into the shared drive during kickoff)
nina-ps: (I'll be at kickoff and can grab them) :+1:
nina-ps: small correction: participant is `ina-sec` below for security
ina-sec: Security checklist: they'll need a signed DPA + KMS integration for keys if using Private. For Hosted, we can offer encrypted-at-rest + customer tenant isolation; SOC2 addendum will be provided. Also ask if PHI allowed — affects hosting option.
sean-sales: PHI is allowed but they prefer Private or Dedicated. Can we run the POC on Dedicated reserved pool for isolation? Procurement asked about committed spend & burst costs.
alex-eng: Dedicated is doable. For a 4-week POC we can spin a small reserved pool (1-2 GPUs) — give them predictable latencies. I will draft a config example and cost ballpark separately.
maria-ml: Evals: propose 500 prompt pairs (gold summary + model output). Acceptance: ROUGE-L/F1 > threshold on >= 90% of prompts and hallucination rate < 5% measured by hallucination-checker.
jordan-ps: Timeline for rollout: week 0 kickoff + data & prompts, week 1 model pipeline + tool mock, week 2 integrated runs + evals, week 3 iterate prompts & threshold tuning, week 4 handoff + ops runbook.
sean-sales: Can someone run the security questionnaire before kickoff? They sent a 15-page vendor sec doc. I can share link in channel.
nina-ps: I'll take the questionnaire. @ina-sec do you want to pair?
ina-sec: yes, send it to me. I can answer technical security bits (KMS, audit logs, network controls).
deploy-bot: Reminder: onboarding playbook created — /playbooks/presales/acmehealth-poc (updated).
sean-sales: Perfect. Action items: @maria-ml compile eval prompt set, @alex-eng draft Dedicated config + cost estimate, @ina-sec + @nina-ps start security questionnaire answers. I'll update procurement with tentative timeline. Anything else?
alex-eng: One extra: confirm tool output schema + allowlist fields to reduce hallucination surface (no free-text EMR dumps).
maria-ml: + We'll include an evaluation that specifically checks for hallucinated lab values vs tool-backed answers.
sean-sales: Great — see you all at kickoff. I'll paste questionnaire + sample data before EOD.
